gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Commanding and a little vintage, Woodgod pushes its tall lowercase right up toward the capitals. Noto Sans Elbasan follows in a modern sans-serif, with large letters and open terminals that keep a long passage easy to move through.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-elymaic:
Noto Sans Elymaic reads clean and modern, its apertures wide open.

Woodgod sits above it with a vintage, commanding voice and tall lowercase, so the page gets one loud personality and one quiet, tidy companion.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Woodgod brings a vintage, commanding look, with generous channels cut into every bowl. And Noto Sans Ethiopic gives it a sturdy plain sans partner, its c terminals hanging far from the bowl; shrink the heading, though, and that swagger fades quickly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Bold vintage swagger up top, with lowercase letters stretching nearly to the capitals and wide channels into every bowl. Noto Sans Georgian then carries a long passage smoothly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-glagolit: Noto Sans Glagolitic is approachable and neutral, with open round letters that stay clear at small sizes and a tall, sturdy lowercase. Woodgod handles the loud vintage part above it.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Modern and professional describes Noto Sans Gothic, whose big, rounded counters look like drilled glass beads. But Woodgod is the one with vintage muscle, built for commanding headings while the sans-serif below simply keeps the text open.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Vintage muscle meets tidy text here. Woodgod commands the top, and Noto Sans Grantha, a plain sans with tall little letters, never snags on a closed-up bowl, so sizing the heading big feels natural.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Loud vintage lettering over a clean, modern sans. And Noto Sans Gujarati supplies the pair's best quality: curved strokes that end before they turn inward, leaving tall a, e and s wide open.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-: Contemporary and modern, Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi has strokes as tall as a thick crayon mark and terminals cut back to leave a big gap, set beneath Woodgod's vintage swagger. A long passage in it moves along easily.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Woodgod is commanding and vintage, with tall lowercase that nearly touches its capitals, and it earns its keep big and short. Noto Sans Gurmukhi takes over below as a clean plain sans, its terminals pointing outward like tongs.
